CFMEE (Hefei Xinqi Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd.)
notes:
SSE STAR Market issuer 688630. Business scope as the filing states it (p15): micro/nano direct-write lithography; R&D, manufacture, sale and maintenance of high-end direct-imaging and direct-write lithography equipment. Product system covers PCB direct-imaging equipment and automated lines, pan-semiconductor direct-write lithography equipment and automated lines, and other laser direct-imaging equipment; the PCB product type as the issuer defines it also contains CO2/UV laser blind-via drilling tools (MUD/MCD). It does NOT make projection/scanner wafer-steppers, and the majority of its revenue is printed-circuit-board equipment, not semiconductor equipment. origin/main staged this firm independently as entity 'cfmee' with pending observations; that staging was superseded by this branch's verified coverage and its identifying names are folded into the aliases above.
